set.body:
Problem
Retained Sherlock NN03 baseline-20260919-nn03-v2, run-1, recall units story:b7282dad210b:u92 and u93 (display rows 93 and 94), exposes a source ranking/non-source interpretation failure. Unit u92 describes a woman lying on the ground; u93 recalls the wet coat collar. Data remain in place under data/study/recall-to-video/baseline-20260919-nn03-v2 and data/sherlock. Do not copy participant transcripts or media into Git or rewrite retained exports.

Observed evidence
u92 local strongest source: seg:sherlock:scene:21, media-part-a 951–963 seconds (Part 1 15:51–16:03), local mass 0.09122191987735498. Intrusion local mass 0.19770244388213734; posterior 0.22334770659796832.
Relevant retrieved candidate sit:sherlock:row:0503, media-part-b 84–94 seconds, describes the camera revealing the dead woman lying facedown. Local mass 0.07248838810427449; posterior 0.07369907764937392. Final anchor is row:0503, origin decode_bound.
Another retrieved candidate row:0507 at Part 2 110–111 seconds describes the men's view of the woman lying facedown in a pink jacket.
u92 scene:21 cost terms: Semantic 0.6160491282056879, Granularity 0, Entity 0.5, Propositional 0.5; total 1.1160201810903294.
u92 row:0503: better Semantic cost 0.4989855579770568, Granularity 0.5, Entity 0.5, Propositional 0.5; total 1.150500506007231. Audit the full composition before attributing the reversal solely to a single term.
u93 strongest source and final anchor: scene:30, media-part-b 103–194 seconds. Local source mass 0.0571754106552682; intrusion 0.5208530886167176. Posterior source mass 0.07146140436970123; intrusion 0.5666936416842061.
Intrusion cost is 1.0 in both retained rows, with no exported component terms. Thus local non-source preference is not calibrated evidence that the recall describes absent content.

Interpretation and scope
This is not simply candidate-retrieval failure: relevant visual descriptions were retrieved but outranked. Investigate cross-grain score comparability, the granularity term, and how non-source alternatives compete with source candidates. Separate weak/diffuse localization from positive evidence of intrusion. Final chronological decoding partially corrects this case but does not establish sound local scores or temporal accuracy.
The R viewer reproduces the retained local weights exactly. Clicking a transcript passage currently follows the strongest source in the selected weight layer, not necessarily a final assignment; UI navigation clarity is a separate downstream issue.
Video-grounded annotation may refine support, but several intervals may legitimately depict the same recalled event. Do not force an exact instant or use a visually cleaner diagonal as validation.

Anti-overfitting and acceptance
1. Treat u92/u93 as known development/regression cases, never independent validation after they influence changes.
2. Fix a general mechanism; no phrase-specific heuristics or parameters chosen only to make this case win. Record the hypothesis and bounded alternatives before tuning.
3. Predefine evaluation across direct matches, paraphrases, ambiguous and repeated events, genuine non-source recalls, and legitimate out-of-order recall.
4. Use held-out participants and movies where feasible; same-scene phrases alone are not an adequate holdout. If independent data are insufficient, distinguish an engineering correction from unvalidated scientific improvement.
5. Obtain reference annotations without showing model ranks; permit multiple supported intervals, uncertainty and abstention.
6. Compare candidate recall, ranking, temporal localization, false intrusion rates and relevant subgroup performance separately, with appropriate participant-level uncertainty. Report adverse cases and regressions, not just aggregate improvements.
7. Compare current scoring against bounded general alternatives (e.g. separate/hierarchical scene-detail ranking and revised non-source handling). Preserve original outputs and bind new results to code/configuration/input hashes.
8. Add a synthetic regression demonstrating the diagnosed mechanism, plus an in-place retained-case check. This case passing is necessary diagnostic evidence, not the sole acceptance criterion.

Evidence locations
run-1/report.tsv.stages.json (costs/local/posterior/anchors), inventory.json (target clocks), report.tsv.voyage.json (decision origins), and data/sherlock/Sherlock_Segments_1000_NN_2017.tsv (source annotations). Existing sibling R audit: ../storymodel/docs/viewer-mapping-audit.md relative paths should be resolved for local layout; actual R repo /Users/bbuchsbaum/code/storymodel. Baseline producer revision recorded as 99344ea01ffd82613b85337d6dd23a49b809f0c7.
set.title: Sherlock NN03 direct-hit misranking: cross-grain costs and intrusion competition
